title: Would not buy.
text: Would not buy.. Paint was already peeled off when I got it and it broke (water globe came unglued from the base) as soon as I opened the box. I sent it back for a refund!

product_metadata.title: Westland Giftware Sparkler Water Globe Figurine, 35mm, Disney Nightmare Before Christmas Jack
description: Westland Giftware's Jack 35MM Sparkler Globe features the Disney Nightmare Before Christmas character figurine on top of a sparkle filled globe. Lights inside the globe change colors 7 times. Westland Giftware is a leading manufacturer of quality collectible gift and home decor items.
